dedupe_keys.name: spanish and horus earthquake catalogues for time dependent hazard analysis

description: This repository publishes two earthquake-event CSV files, Spanish_catalogue.csv and HORUS_filtered.csv, for a manuscript on time-dependent seismic activity rates. Its field explanation defines event identifier and UTC time components, WGS84 longitude and latitude, depth in kilometres, moment magnitude, magnitude uncertainty, completeness magnitude and optional cluster identifier. For the Spanish file, the authors name the Gardner-Knopoff declustering method and explain that zero magnitude-error values may mean that the original IGN record lacked an uncertainty or did not need conversion. A seismic modeller could use the events to compare declustered and undeclustered catalogues or test hazard-forecast input sensitivity. The repo provides the tabular inputs themselves, not a complete operational forecasting service. The event periods, HORUS geographic coverage, processing scripts and manuscript publication status were not confirmed from the short README. No CSV was downloaded, so row counts and value ranges remain untested. GitHub metadata reports MIT for the repository, and a LICENSE file appears in its tree. Related earthquake-catalogue resources could be compared by event coverage, but no exact catalogue record for this two-file package was found in the local index.
name: Spanish and HORUS earthquake catalogues for time-dependent hazard analysis
notes: G8; G8-0807. Metadata and documentation checked. Data payloads and software execution were not tested. Simulation uses are curator interpretations. Manuscript named by repository; bibliographic status not verified..
